dataset.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) is developed for the postdoctoral research project “Use of Algal Biomass in the Production of Carbon-Cured Cement, LC3, and Alkali-Activated Geopolymer Composites” (Project No. 1.1.1.9/LZP/2/25/290) funded under Activity 1.1.1.9 “Post-doctoral Research” of the European Union Cohesion Policy Programme 2021–2027.

The project investigates the integration of algal biomass into sustainable cementitious materials, including OPC, LC3, and alkali-activated geopolymer composites combined with carbonation curing technologies to reduce CO₂ emissions and improve material performance. The research will generate experimental datasets related to material composition, mechanical and durability testing, microstructural characterization (e.g., SEM, XRD, FTIR), and environmental assessments such as Life Cycle Assessment (LCA).

The purpose of this DMP is to ensure that research data generated during the project are properly collected, documented, stored, and shared. Data management will follow FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) and support transparency, reproducibility, and Open Science practices.

distribution.title: The data will be generated through experimental laboratory research aimed at developing sustainable cementitious materials incorporating algal biomass and carbonation curing technologies. The collected data will support the evaluation of material performance, including mechanical properties, durability behavior, microstructural characteristics, and environmental impacts. These datasets will contribute to achieving the project objectives of improving the sustainability and performance of cement-based materials while reducing CO₂ emissions in the construction sector.
